facts.fact: ITWeb Africa reports on 2026-07-22 that Kenya's National AI Strategy (2025-2030) is in place and that the draft AI policy forms part of it (document gives no adoption date).
The ministry opened a draft AI policy for public consultation on 2026-07-21, with comments due 4 August 2026, per ITWeb Africa.
